Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/19306/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/19306/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261017013632/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/19306/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' TRIUMPH
* '''Published:''' 11 October 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''My first deck on Decktech CCT''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif|label=Carbon Chamber Testing}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PCor CCT TRIUMPH DS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' The best CCT that I can come up with.  This is my first deck so please help me with it. And please give me some good ratings if you can do so.  THANX

== Original post ==

'''My first deck on Decktech CCT'''
* '''Author:''' Rik "TRIUMPH" Emmit
* '''Published:''' October 11, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' The best CCT that I can come up with.  This is my first deck so please help me with it. And please give me some good ratings if you can do so.  THANX

=== Strategy ===

Wow this is mega mega<right> The deck is your basic CCT with jabba's prize. this deck needs work i know Tell me what you think I need to add or take out.  I have had some fun with it at a great many tourneys and have won alot more than I have lost.  It just needs some work.  Please be kind with the ratings.
